license: LGPL, as declared by the airway package DESCRIPTION
review: The package is the exact version named in the workflow session. Its selected samples have no albuterol treatment. Matrix slots and row/column identities are extracted without numerical transformation; metadata labels are explicitly mapped from dex trt/untrt to treated/control. Primary public counts are redistributable with source attribution; package source remains available under its declared LGPL license. No patient identifiers or controlled-access data are included.
compute: Gene counts only; no FASTQ alignment or genome download. Runs are bounded to 2 CPUs, 4 GiB memory, 10 minutes and no network by default.
